definitions.active_dev: contributor with at least one authored (non-merge) commit, opened PR or review (comment or review) in the year; bots excluded
definitions.location: where the contributor was in that year: a profile or email observed that year, or the current location carried back when that year's commit timezone agrees or is unknown. A contradicting timezone gives the region only. See coverage.basis_share.
definitions.privacy: countries are listed, and activity totals given, only for cells with at least 5 contributors; smaller cells show headcount only (totals null)
